"""Straightforward reference implementation of PROTOCOL.md (slow, exact)."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import topo

class Ref:
    def __init__(self, session):
        spec = session['topology']
        self.n, self.tmpl, self.dom = topo.build(spec)
        self.fps = [set(f) for (s, d, f) in self.tmpl]
        self.caps = list(session['caps'])
        assert len(self.caps) == self.n
        self.quota = [g[0] for g in session['groups']]
        self.budget = [g[1] for g in session['groups']]
        self.G = len(self.quota)
        self.tasks = [dict(template=t[0], group=t[1], weight=t[2], klass=t[3], pin=t[4]) for t in session['tasks']]
        self.revision = 0
        v = self.violations(self.tasks, self.quota, self.budget, self.caps)
        assert v == [0, 0, 0, 0], ('illegal initial', v)

    def aggregates(self, tasks, quota):
        G = len(quota)
        members = [[] for _ in range(G)]
        for i, t in enumerate(tasks):
            members[t['group']].append(i)
        foot = [set() for _ in range(G)]
        load = [0]*G
        pairs = [set() for _ in range(G)]
        for g in range(G):
            for i in members[g]:
                t = tasks[i]
                foot[g] |= self.fps[t['template']]
                load[g] += t['weight']
                pairs[g].add((self.dom[t['template']], t['klass']))
        usage = [0]*self.n
        for g in range(G):
            if members[g]:
                for v in foot[g]:
                    usage[v] += quota[g]
        return members, foot, load, pairs, usage

    def violations(self, tasks, quota, budget, caps, start=None):
        members, foot, load, pairs, usage = self.aggregates(tasks, quota)
        capv = sum(1 for v in range(self.n) if usage[v] > caps[v])
        mixed = sum(1 for g in range(self.G) if len(pairs[g]) > 1)
        work = sum(1 for g in range(self.G) if members[g] and (quota[g] == 0 or load[g] > quota[g]*budget[g]))
        pins = 0
        if start is not None:
            stasks, squatas = start
            for i, t0 in enumerate(stasks):
                if not t0['pin']:
                    continue
                t1 = tasks[i]
                bad = (t1['group'] != t0['group'] or t1['template'] != t0['template']
                       or t1['weight'] != t0['weight'] or t1['klass'] != t0['klass']
                       or quota[t0['group']] != squatas[t0['group']])
                if bad:
                    pins += 1
        return [capv, mixed, work, pins]

    def certificate(self, q):
        tasks, quota, budget, caps = self.tasks, self.quota, self.budget, self.caps
        members, foot, load, pairs, usage = self.aggregates(tasks, quota)
        active = sum(1 for g in range(self.G) if members[g])
        slots = sum(usage)
        weight = sum(t['weight'] for t in tasks)
        pins = sum(1 for t in tasks if t['pin'])
        grows = []
        for g in q['groups']:
            if members[g]:
                (dm, cl) = next(iter(pairs[g]))
            else:
                dm, cl = -1, -1
            grows.append([g, len(members[g]), load[g], quota[g], budget[g], len(foot[g]), dm, cl])
        nrows = [[v, usage[v], caps[v]] for v in q['nodes']]
        trows = [[i, tasks[i]['group'], tasks[i]['template'], tasks[i]['weight'], tasks[i]['klass'], tasks[i]['pin']] for i in q['tasks']]
        return {'totals': [active, slots, weight, pins], 'groups': grows, 'nodes': nrows, 'tasks': trows}

    def transact(self, tx):
        if tx['revision'] != self.revision:
            return {'accepted': False, 'revision': self.revision, 'violations': None, 'certificate': self.certificate(tx['query'])}
        start = ([dict(t) for t in self.tasks], list(self.quota))
        tasks = [dict(t) for t in self.tasks]
        quota = list(self.quota); budget = list(self.budget); caps = list(self.caps)
        for op, idx, val in tx['edits']:
            if op == 'move': tasks[idx]['group'] = val
            elif op == 'weight': tasks[idx]['weight'] = val
            elif op == 'class': tasks[idx]['klass'] = val
            elif op == 'bind': tasks[idx]['template'] = val
            elif op == 'pin': tasks[idx]['pin'] = val
            elif op == 'quota': quota[idx] = val
            elif op == 'budget': budget[idx] = val
            elif op == 'cap': caps[idx] = val
        v = self.violations(tasks, quota, budget, caps, start)
        if v == [0, 0, 0, 0]:
            self.tasks, self.quota, self.budget, self.caps = tasks, quota, budget, caps
            self.revision += 1
            accepted = True
        else:
            accepted = False
        return {'accepted': accepted, 'revision': self.revision, 'violations': v, 'certificate': self.certificate(tx['query'])}

def run(request):
    sessions = []
    for s in request['sessions']:
        ref = Ref(s)
        initial = ref.certificate(s['query'])
        outs = [ref.transact(tx) for tx in s['transactions']]
        sessions.append({'nodes': ref.n, 'templates': len(ref.tmpl), 'initial': initial, 'transactions': outs})
    return {'sessions': sessions}
